finding.claim: wipe() calls requireRole(u, "OWNER") but discards its boolean return value, so the OWNER check is a no-op and any caller can reach repo.wipe(tenant).
finding.source: Request-supplied User u and tenant path parameter on POST /tenants/{t}/wipe (per comment at Admin.java:24).

Returns u.roles().contains(role) with no exception on failure
Return value of requireRole ignored; no if/throw

finding.guards_checked: requireRole return value (ignored, so no enforcement). No other auth check visible in Admin.java; router/auth filter not in repo. Compare export() at line 32 which uses checkRole and does throw.

verdict.guard_found: Only in-file control is requireRole at src/Admin.java:14-16, which returns a boolean and never throws. Its result is discarded as a bare statement at src/Admin.java:26, so no enforcement happens before repo.wipe(tenant) at line 27. The throwing checkRole (lines 18-22) is used only by export() at line 32, not wipe(). No router or auth filter is in the repo to check.
verdict.reason: wipe() at src/Admin.java:26 discards the boolean from requireRole, so the OWNER check never blocks the call to repo.wipe(tenant) at line 27, while the intended OWNER-only power is reachable by any caller who reaches this method. The trace matches the code, and the only caveat is that the router is not in the repo, so an upstream guard cannot be ruled out.

finding.claim: Roles on User are global (single Set<String>), not bound to a tenant. OWNER in one tenant satisfies the check for any tenant argument, enabling cross-tenant export/wipe if the router does not verify membership.
finding.source: Authenticated user with OWNER role in tenant A supplies tenant B id in the path.
finding.sink: repo.export(tenant) at Admin.java:33 and repo.wipe(tenant) at Admin.java:27.

trace.note: User record has no tenant field; roles are a flat Set<String>
checkRole checks role presence only, not tenant
export checks OWNER globally then acts on arbitrary tenant

finding.guards_checked: checkRole/requireRole membership test only. No tenant-membership check in Admin.java; upstream router not available to confirm.

verdict.guard_found: Admin.java:18-22 checkRole is a role-presence check that throws on failure, with no tenant comparison; Admin.java:14-16 requireRole returns a bool and has no tenant comparison either. No tenant-membership check exists in Admin.java, but the upstream router that builds User and binds the tenant path is not in the repo.
verdict.reason: The trace lines at Admin.java:4, 18, 32 and 33 match the candidate's description (the User record has no tenant field, and export checks a global OWNER role and then calls repo.export(tenant) on the request's tenant), but whether a cross-tenant OWNER can reach this depends on how the router populates User.roles and validates the tenant, and that code is not in the repo. Separately, Admin.java:26 discards requireRole's boolean result, so wipe() at line 27 has no authorization at all for any authenticated caller, a more serious bug the candidate did not report.
